item.title: Omnichannel POS and E-commerce CSV Data Cleaning & Excel Model
item.description: Looking for an analytics specialist to clean weekly retail store POS CSVs and online store order data. Remove duplicate rows, handle missing customer IDs, generate monthly sales trend charts, and format a professional multi-tab Excel workbook. Cleaned CSV and summary presentation required. Budget: ₹5,000 for 2 hours.

item.title: Marketplace Fees vs Bank Settlement Discrepancy Reconciliation
item.description: Need automated reconciliation for Amazon and Flipkart commission fees vs actual bank credit statement rows. Deduplicate transaction IDs, identify overcharged commission rates, and provide an automated Python script with test suite and reconciled CSV. Budget: ₹10,000 for 3 hours.

item.title: Customer Retention & Repeat Purchase Executive HTML Dashboard
item.description: We need an offline HTML5 interactive dashboard for our founder review. Takes raw customer transaction CSV and provides interactive KPI cards, cohort distribution visuals, and searchable product tables with zero external cloud dependencies. Budget: ₹20,000 for 6 hours.
